name: design-week
title: Design review this week
subtitle: Internal working paper. Scores and evidence are entered by reviewers. This is not certification that a system is secure.

sections.title: Model review state
sections.sql: select code,name,owner,next_review,attention,high_open from review_desk order by code

sections.title: Open high-risk assessments
sections.sql: select model,code,name,score,owner,due_on from threat_desk where disposition='open' and score>=60 order by score desc

sections.title: Controls awaiting evidence
sections.sql: select model,code,name,owner,due_on,attention from control_desk where not verified order by due_on nulls first

name: boundaries
title: Trust boundary review
subtitle: Internal working paper. Scores and evidence are entered by reviewers. This is not certification that a system is secure.

sections.title: Data movements
sections.sql: select model,code,source_component,target_component,source_zone,target_zone,boundary,protocol,threats from boundary_desk order by model,code

name: decisions
title: Risk decisions and verification
subtitle: Internal working paper. Scores and evidence are entered by reviewers. This is not certification that a system is secure.

sections.title: Risk acceptances
sections.sql: select model,code,name,accepted_by,acceptance_expires,disposition from threat_desk where acceptance_expires is not null order by acceptance_expires

sections.title: Verified controls
sections.sql: select model,code,name,verifier,verified_on,evidence from control_desk where verified order by model,code
